releaseNotes: ClickAirV2 v8 Owner QA fixes HONOR Android 16 OTA installer APK-read permission handoff. To update FROM v7, its old in-app installer cannot install: STOP ClickAirV2, then open this v8 release APK from Downloads/File Manager or use USB ADB install -r; do NOT uninstall or clear data. v8 keeps v7 Floating and Instant Reject behavior; Job Pool → Upcoming Sync remains unresolved. Future in-app installer effectiveness still requires a later supervised device check.
